title: Zesty Light American Natto Salad
description: A pungent and light American dish featuring natto, perfect for a festive occasion, served in a scallop shell. This recipe is Buddhist-temple-friendly and uses shio-koji cure for added flavor.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Add the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion to the bowl and toss to combine.
In a small bowl, mix together natto and shio-koji until well combined.
Add the natto mixture to the bowl with the salad and toss to combine.
Spoon the salad into scallop shells and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional cherry tomatoes and cucumber slices if desired.
Cover and refrigerate any leftovers for up to 24 hours.
Before serving, give the salad a good stir and adjust the seasoning if needed.
